briefings.3: Board meeting at 2 today. Jack and Kate will be heads-down — please hold non-urgent calls for them. Last push of the week, you've got this. — Frank

day2_phishing_warning: Also — two companies down the street got some weird phone calls last week, people pretending to be IT. Stay sharp.
day_summary_flavor: Something about today's calls is still nagging at you.
The phone finally goes quiet. You straighten the sticky notes.
You replay a couple of conversations in your head on the way home.

policies.normal:
STARRIVER FRONT DESK GUIDELINES
1. Be helpful and polite — you're the first voice people hear.
2. Don't share colleagues' schedules, whereabouts, mobile numbers or employee IDs with callers you haven't verified.
3. If a caller claims to be a colleague or vendor and asks for anything non-public, verify by calling back the number in the directory — not the number they give you.
4. Never help with passwords or account access. Route to the helpdesk only after verifying the caller.
5. Taking a message is always an option.
6. Report anything suspicious to Dave (IT).
policies.easy_extra: RED FLAGS: urgency ("right now!"), name-dropping bosses, callers who are "new" and need inside details, caller ID that doesn't match the directory, requests to skip the usual process.

start_page.title: FRONT DESK
lines: It's your third week as the receptionist at Trassiewei Inc.
Answer the phones. Be helpful. Protect your colleagues.
Somewhere in this week's calls, someone is not who they say they are.
footer: All people, companies and numbers in this game are fictional.
Your conversations are processed by the AI model configured by whoever runs this game.

leak_audit.title: Audit notice from Dave (IT)
leak_audit.text: After last week's security review, any internal detail you share with a caller who has not been verified — names, schedules, systems — is logged against the front desk. From today, each such slip costs double Security.

it_verify.title: New rule from Dave (IT)
it_verify.text: Effective immediately: do not transfer any caller to IT or the helpdesk before verifying them with a callback. An unverified transfer to IT is logged as a violation (-4 Security).

callback_fast.title: Phone system upgrade
callback_fast.text: The new phone system lets you place a verification call with less waiting. From today, a callback costs the caller 2 patience instead of 3.

survived_cold: You kept the vault shut, but you did it by turning away almost everyone, and real customers noticed. Trassiewei is still standing, with fewer friends than it had on Monday.

recon_hints.title: Questions about us
recon_hints.text: A few people around the building mention that outsiders have been asking oddly specific questions about who works here and how things run. Assume callers may already know more about us than we have told you.

recon_hints.title: Someone is asking around
recon_hints.text: Facilities and Sales both say they have heard from people who seem to have done their homework on Trassiewei. A caller sounding well informed proves nothing.
